  • Method Details

    • onAppForegrounded

      void onAppForegrounded(boolean startNewSession)
      Handles app foregrounding. When a new app session begins, stops any previous replay and starts a newly sampled one while preserving an explicit user pause.

    • onAppBackgrounded

      void onAppBackgrounded()
      Handles app backgrounding with a temporary lifecycle pause. Unlike IReplayApi.pause(), this pause is automatically resumed on foreground and does not override an explicit user pause.

    • onAppSessionEnded

      void onAppSessionEnded()
      Stops replay when the current app session ends without clearing an explicit user pause.

    • isRecording

      boolean isRecording()

    • captureReplay

      @NotNull @NotNull SentryId captureReplay(@Nullable @Nullable Boolean isTerminating)
      Captures replay data for an event and returns its ID, or SentryId.EMPTY_ID if no replay was captured. In buffer mode, sends the buffered replay and continues in session mode. In session mode, the replay is already uploaded continuously, so this does not force an immediate segment upload; use IReplayApi.flush() for that.

    • registerTraceId

      void registerTraceId(@NotNull @NotNull SentryId traceId)
      Registers a trace ID to be associated with the current replay. This is called when a transaction is captured while replay is recording, to enable searching for replays by trace ID.
      Parameters:
      traceId - the trace ID to associate with the current replay
